anchor: Language-pool week replay (651 ms / 518.6 GPU-h; p50, Toto, TimesFM, reactive arms)
claim_text: Language-pool week replay: 651 ms / 518.6 GPU-h at p50 with Toto, TimesFM, reactive arms

adjudication.observed: p99_ms=651.14 (p50_ms=22.65), gpu_hours=518.61 for planner:week_fc_p90 (forecast/null); toto: p99=651.14, gpu_hours=625.27; timesfm: p99=651.14, gpu_hours=641.08; reactive: p99=1196.57, gpu_hours=281.79; p50-forecast: p99=827.81, gpu_hours=319.91
adjudication.evidence: 651 ms is the p99 TTFT latency of the p90-forecast runs (not p50, which is ~22.65 ms); 518.6 GPU-h is the cost of the base p90-forecast run with null model, not a p50-forecast run (319.91 GPU-h) or runs with Toto (625.27 GPU-h), TimesFM (641.08 GPU-h), or reactive arms (281.79 GPU-h).
adjudication.fix: Correct 'at p50' to 'at p99' and drop the 'Toto, TimesFM, reactive arms' attribution from these specific numbers, or cite the distinct costs/latencies of those individual configurations.
adjudication.query: SELECT l.run_id, l.policy, l.forecast_model, l.quantile, l.p50_ms, l.p99_ms, c.gpu_hours FROM v_pool_latency l JOIN v_pool_cost c USING (run_id, pool, window_name, is_current) WHERE l.is_current = true AND l.experiment = 'planner' AND l.pool = 'language' AND l.window_name = 'aggregate' AND l.sla_metric = 'ttft';

adjudication.observed: For 749601 requests, 651.1395369768143 ms is TTFT p99 for planner p90/Toto/TimesFM; their p50 is 22.493120789527893–22.652428030967712 ms. The planner p50 arm has TTFT p99 827.8129093647003 ms, while reactive has p99 1191.6285899281502–1196.5717934966087 ms. v_pool_latency contains no GPU-hour value.
adjudication.evidence: The claim conflates the 651.1395 ms p99 of p90/Toto/TimesFM forecast runs with p50 and reactive arms, and the owning view does not back 518.6 GPU-h.
adjudication.fix: Report 651.14 ms explicitly as TTFT p99 for the p90/Toto/TimesFM forecast runs, report their approximately 22.49–22.65 ms p50 separately, exclude reactive from that value, and cite an owning GPU-usage view for 518.6 GPU-h or remove it.
adjudication.query: SELECT run_id, window_name, policy, forecast_model, quantile, sla_metric, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, max_ms, n_requests, is_current, source_relation FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = TRUE AND pool = 'language' AND run_id IN ('planner:week_fc_p50','planner:week_fc_p90','planner:week_fc_p90_toto','planner:week_fc_p90_timesfm','planner:week_re','a12:week_fc_toto','a12:week_fc_timesfm','a12:week_reactive') ORDER BY run_id, sla_metric
